description: Portfolio optimizer (efficient frontier) — Mean-variance portfolio optimization from price or return history. series=NAME:v1,v2,...;NAME:... (2-12 assets, prices oldest first, 11-1001 points). Optional type=returns (percent, or unit=decimal), period= per year (252 daily, 52 weekly, 12 monthly), rf= risk-free %, long_only=false (closed-form Markowitz with shorting), max_weight= / min_weight= %, target= annual return %, shrinkage=0-1 covariance shrink, current=NAME:pct;... to compare. Returns max-Sharpe, minimum-variance, risk-parity, equal-weight (and target/current) portfolios with weights, expected return, volatility, Sharpe, risk contributions, diversification ratio and effective assets, the efficient frontier, rebalance trades and data-quality flags. Long-only results match SciPy SLSQP. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_portfolio_optimize
